description: This file defines various autograd function classes related to error handling, unimplemented derivatives, delayed errors, undefined gradients, and the autograd graph root within the PyTorch autograd system.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Base class for error-related autograd nodes, holding an error message.

classes.name: NotImplemented
classes.description: Represents unimplemented derivatives for certain functions.

classes.name: DelayedError
classes.description: Represents an error that is delayed until backward pass, used for @once_differentiable functions.

classes.name: UndefinedGradBackward
classes.description: Backward node for undefined gradients, with support for applying with saved variables.

classes.name: GraphRoot
classes.description: Represents the root node of an autograd graph, holding output variables.

classes.name: Identity
classes.description: A simple autograd node that outputs its input unchanged.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the autograd operation to the given variables.

methods.name: compiled_args
methods.description: Prepares compiled arguments for autograd nodes.

methods.name: apply_with_saved
methods.description: Applies the autograd operation with saved variables.
